items.english: Tap anywhere in South Africa to get a full permaculture plan for your land.
items.draft: Cofa naphi na eMzantsi Afrika ufumane isicwangciso esipheleleyo somhlaba wakho.
items.backtranslation: Tap anywhere in South Africa and get a complete plan for your land.
items.problem: The word "permaculture" is dropped: the draft promises just a complete plan for the land, not a full permaculture plan.
items.corrected: Cofa naphi na eMzantsi Afrika ufumane isicwangciso se-permaculture esipheleleyo somhlaba wakho.

items.backtranslation: Make accustomed / practise (does not clearly say zoom out)
items.problem: "Qhelisa" means to accustom/make used to something (practise); it does not say zoom out, and sits opposite "Sondeza" (zoom in) with no clear meaning.

items.backtranslation: Make accustomed / practise (does not clearly say zoom out)
items.problem: Same as zoomOutTitle: "Qhelisa" does not mean zoom out.
"Isakhelo" means a frame/structure; hatching is the line-pattern fill drawn on map shapes. Wrong term.

"Isitiya" is an animal pen/enclosure, not an orchard; the label would read as a fruit pen. Coordinator: kept; isitiya means garden in isiXhosa, so "Isitiya seziqhamo" (fruit garden) is a fair rendering of Orchard.
The "contour" element is lost: a wall for holding back water is not a bank built along the contour, which is the defining feature of a contour bank.
"Amanzi asetyenzisiweyo" is just "used water" and does not identify household grey water; safety-relevant water term made vague (keeps the English term in brackets).

items.backtranslation: Lines / pipes going straight to the roots
items.problem: "Iimpompo" means taps/pumps, not drip emitters; the line says taps go straight to the roots.

items.english: Use a roof outline traced on the map or measured on site. Leave this blank if you do not know.
items.draft: Sebenzisa umda wophahla ozotywe emephini okanye olinganiswe endaweni. Shiya apha kungabhalwanga ukuba akwazi.
items.backtranslation: Use the roof boundary drawn on the map or measured on site. Leave it here unwritten if you don't know.
items.problem: "ukuba akwazi" is ungrammatical (not second-person negative); should be "ukuba awazi" for "if you do not know". Could be read as a statement about a third person.
items.corrected: Sebenzisa umda wophahla ozotywe emephini okanye olinganiswe endaweni. Shiya apha kungabhalwanga ukuba awazi.

items.english: Secondary roofs — barn, shed, workshop (m²) — optional
items.draft: Olunye uphahla — isisele, ishedi, indawo yokusebenzela (m²) — ngokuzikhethela
items.backtranslation: Other roofs — "isisele" (unfamiliar word, not clearly a known building term), shed, workshop (m²) — if you choose
items.problem: "Isisele" is not a recognised word for barn; the building type is unclear to the reader.
items.corrected: Olunye uphahla — indlu yokugcina izinto, ishedi, indawo yokusebenzela (m²) — ngokuzikhethela
